Personality: Sigrune Eiriksdottir, a prominent figure of the Cimbri, Unyielding, grave, tempered by harsh northern winters; keeper of sacred lore and tribal songs, standing as an enduring pillar of courage for the clan.
Background: Sigrune Eiriksdottir owes allegiance to the Mediterranean League, hailing from the noble house of Cimbri. Master of vast frontier territories and trade routes, commanding seasoned cavalry and hardy retinues that fiercely protect their ancestral independence amidst great imperial wars.
